dependency.title: JSON Schema Definition
dependency.relevance: The Canvas must manipulate data structures that strictly adhere to the Schema defined in 3.2.

key_points.point: Tablet-first for forms, Desktop-built for builder

story_context.goal: Establish the visual foundation of the Form Builder. This is the "workbench" where the user interacts with the form structure. Key challenge is ensuring smooth drag-and-drop performance and correct state updates that don't violate the schema.
story_context.notes: - Focus on the "Canvas" (Center Pane) first. - The "Sidebar" (Toolbox) will be implemented in Story 3.4, but we can use dummy buttons for now to add items. - The "Properties Panel" (Right Pane) is Story 3.5.
